resources.string: The deployer sets API_TOKEN. In a Docker management panel, open this app’s API container and find the API_TOKEN environment variable, or check the deployment directory’s .env file. It is not GPG_KEY or DOCKERHUB_TOKEN, and you do not request it from GitHub. If you are not the deployer, ask the administrator.
An external address for the same server and database. Used when the primary address is unreachable. Leave empty to disable automatic fallback.
